text:
priya: FYI nightly eval spike on prompt_set_v3 after merging fused softmax microkernel yesterday.
priya: failure rate went from 0.7% -> 4.9% on deterministic seeds, same model + quant profile.
sam: ouch. any quick reproducer? can you paste the gen and the logits diff?
priya: here's one example — golden vs current (top tokens):
```
# prompt: "Write a short summary of the following article..."
GOLDEN_TOP5: ["the", "a", "of", "in", "and"]
CURRENT_TOP5: ["the", "and", "to", "a", "of"]
LOGIT_DELTA_TOP1: -2.3
```
priya: not huge but consistent shift to more common tokens, affects perplexity and some eval pass/fail thresholds.
maya: did we change softmax precision or any scaling in the fused kernel? I know fusing changed accumulation order.
dena: looking at the kernel diff: we switched to pairwise add then exp, and used fp16 intermediate for exp table. also entropy-stable rescale changed placement.
leo: ci-bot nightly run output attached: `ci-bot: nightly-eval-1769992200-artifacts uploaded` — artifact link in build log (internal)
sam: can we toggle the fused kernel in a build and rerun a small eval sweep? need to confirm causality before rolling back.
priya: I've queued a quick branch build with old softmax path, will run 500 prompts locally. ETA ~20m.
maya: also please run single-step RNG-seed fixed runs to rule out sampler interaction (this smells like a deterministic numeric diff though).
dena: note: quant profile uses q8h symmetric scaling; the fused path changed pre-quant clipping order. might amplify tiny fp16 errors.
priya: good catch. I'll run both: (1) fused softmax + original clipping, (2) unfused softmax + new clipping.
sam: if it's the clipping order -> small delta amplified by softmax -> sampling/topk differences. we should add a unit test comparing topk stability across kernels for a set of seeds.
maya: agree. add a golden-topk test in eng-runtime/test_integration/topk_stability.test, target failure <0.2% divergence.
leo: FYI I saw similar drift in a different nightly but dismissed as noise. reopening that prod run to see overlap.
ci-bot: deploy-check: no promoted builds affected. only nightly branch.
priya: local run done (500 prompts): fused path failure rate 4.8%, unfused 0.9% (matches pre-merge). attaching small diff CSV to artifact store.
sam: ok that nails it. next steps: revert fused change or adjust precision/ordering to match unfused outputs.
dena: I'll prototype preserving higher-precision accumulation for exp and moving rescale back; push a PR to eng-runtime/tooling when ready.
priya: thanks. I've filed an incident-esque ticket in #incidents and linked eval artifacts. ping me for the PR review.
maya: :thumbsup: and add a note to the release checklist: run topk_stability test before merging any fused kernels.
priya: good plan. closing the loop here once PR lands.
